pkgmetadata.longdescription: Craft Agents is an open-source, agent-native desktop app by Craft Docs Ltd. This package builds the Electron app from source: it installs dependencies with bun, replicates the staging steps of upstream apps/electron/scripts/build-linux.sh (vendored bun runtime, Claude Agent SDK core + native binary, @vscode/ripgrep, network interceptor sources), runs `bun run electron:build`, and packages the app with electron-builder (--dir, no AppImage) into /opt/craft-agents.

Craft Agents 是 Craft Docs Ltd. 开源的 agent 原生桌面应用。 本包从源码构建 Electron 应用：使用 bun 安装依赖，复刻上游 apps/electron/scripts/build-linux.sh 的 staging 步骤（内置 bun 运行时、 Claude Agent SDK 核心与原生二进制、@vscode/ripgrep、网络拦截器源码）， 执行 `bun run electron:build`，并用 electron-builder（--dir，不生成 AppImage）打包到 /opt/craft-agents。
